{"items":[
{"type":"obligation","text":"In accordance with State law, AACPS commits to implementing best practices on data governance and professional development on data governance policies and procedures.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"In accordance with State law"},
{"type":"definition","term":"Data Owner","text":"Data Owner - an individual who has the requisite knowledge, administrative control, and has been officially designated as accountable for specific data elements or data sets."},
{"type":"definition","term":"Data Steward","text":"Data Steward - an individual who is responsible for maintaining data quality and security."},
{"type":"definition","term":"Education Records","text":"Education Records - those records that are directly related to a student and maintained by AACPS or by a party acting for AACPS."},
{"type":"definition","term":"Personally Identifiable Information","text":"Personally Identifiable Information - information that, alone or in combination, makes it possible to identify an individual student with reasonable certainty."},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall continuously improve the availability, integrity, and security of data systems through the development and enforcement of laws, policies, and regulations.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"through the development and enforcement of laws, policies, and regulations"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Accordingly, data privacy protection of AACPS technology, related data, and electronic communications shall be in accordance with Policy DI and Regulation DI-RA - Technology Use and Security.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"in accordance with Policy DI and Regulation DI-RA - Technology Use and Security"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Policy DI","cited_instrument":"Policy DI"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Regulation DI-RA - Technology Use and Security","cited_instrument":"Regulation DI-RA"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall have a data privacy and security incident response plan.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall have a security breach notification plan.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall maintain cyber security incident response guidelines and data breach notification procedures.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall: a. Create and implement a data classification plan for all AACPS data to determine data sensitivity levels;","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Establish and maintain security controls to be implemented, in accordance with the classification plan, for each identified data security level.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"in accordance with the classification plan"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"The Superintendent or the Chief Information Officer shall identify and assign data owners and data stewards who shall oversee the collection, use, sharing, and destruction of data.","force":"obligation","binds":"The Superintendent or the Chief Information Officer","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall establish procedures and requirements for allowing access to student data and personally identifiable information (PII) for a legitimate research purpose.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Electronic resources containing student PII may only be approved for use in accordance with the following data privacy guidelines.","force":"prohibition","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"in accordance with the following data privacy guidelines"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Communications between the client software, including web browsers, file uploads, file downloads, and the system and data at rest, shall be encrypted using current Federal Information Processing Standard 140-2 or another AACPSapproved equivalent standard to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of AACPS-owned data.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"using current Federal Information Processing Standard 140-2 or another AACPSapproved equivalent standard"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Federal Information Processing Standard 140-2","cited_instrument":"FIPS 140-2"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Cloud-hosted system providers shall warrant that the resource it will provide to AACPS is fully compliant with the following laws and regulations, if applicable:","force":"obligation","binds":"Cloud-hosted system providers","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"reference","text":"Children's Online Privacy Protection Act","cited_instrument":"COPPA"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act","cited_instrument":"FERPA"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act","cited_instrument":"HIPAA"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Maryland Student Date Privacy Act of 2015","cited_instrument":"Maryland Student Data Privacy Act of 2015"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Cloud-hosted systems must adhere to National Institute of Standards and Technology SP 800-144 Guidelines on Security and Privacy in Public Cloud Computing .","force":"obligation","binds":"Cloud-hosted systems","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":null},
{"type":"reference","text":"National Institute of Standards and Technology SP 800-144 Guidelines on Security and Privacy in Public Cloud Computing","cited_instrument":"NIST SP 800-144"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Instructional digital resources containing PII shall be reviewed and approved in accordance with Policy IH and Regulation IH-RA - Materials of Instruction - Review, Evaluation, and Selection.","force":"obligation","binds":null,"responsible_party_stated":false,"mechanism_stated":"in accordance with Policy IH and Regulation IH-RA - Materials of Instruction - Review, Evaluation, and Selection"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Policy IH","cited_instrument":"Policy IH"},
{"type":"reference","text":"Regulation IH-RA - Materials of Instruction - Review, Evaluation, and Selection","cited_instrument":"Regulation IH-RA"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"Prior to use, non-instructional digital resources containing PII must be reviewed and approved by the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee in accordance with the procedures established in this regulation.","force":"obligation","binds":"the Chief Information Officer or the Chief Information Officer's designee","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"Prior to use"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall notify students and parents/guardians annually of their rights under FERPA.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"annually"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS employees who access and maintain FERPA-protected data shall complete appropriate FERPA training annually.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS employees who access and maintain FERPA-protected data","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"annually"},
{"type":"obligation","text":"AACPS shall follow best practices as established by the Maryland State Department of Education to ensure transparency in data sharing with third parties.","force":"obligation","binds":"AACPS","responsible_party_stated":true,"mechanism_stated":"best practices as established by the Maryland State Department of Education"},
{"type":"reference","text":"20 U.S.C. § 1232g","cited_instrument":"20 U.S.C. § 1232g"},
{"type":"reference","text":"34 CFR Part 99","cited_instrument":"34 CFR Part 99"}
]}
